newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks plunge, end 2.32 pct lower.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks plunge, end 2.32 pct lower.

text.p: Pakistani stocks plunged on Monday amid political uncertainty before the February 3 general elections and ended 2.32 percent lower when the market reopened after five holidays, dealers said.
The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index closed 31.87 points, or 2.32 percent, lower at 1,343.68 amid 203 losers and 41 gainers. Volume rose to 27 million shares from Tuesday's 24 million.
Dealer Suleman Iqbal attributed the fall to the prevailing political uncertainty and said there was no immediate hope of recovery in the depressed market.
The market remained bearish throughout the day as foreign and local institutions were net sellers, one broker said.

PTCL dived 1.20 rupees to 25.75, HUBCO 0.85 to 31.40, ICI 0.75 to 17.40, Dawood Hercules 6.00 to 140, PSO 6.00 to 257, Muslim Commercial Bank 2.75 to 32.50, Engro 2.00 to 137, Fauji Fertilizer 1.90 to 66.50 and Adamjee Insurance 1.75 to 87.75.
